style_lock: Warm low-saturation hand-painted storybook 2D art for a fixed 3/4 top-down cozy rural life simulation. Paper and wood UI language, soft foliage, readable silhouettes, rounded simple characters, gentle countryside mood, no combat.
negative_prompt: Do not copy any existing game, anime, movie, artist, map, character, or named style. No photorealism, no combat, no monsters, no weapons, no armor, no HP bars, no loot, no horror, no harsh neon, no sci-fi HUD, no watermark, no random text baked into UI or world art.

rules.component_assets: For HomeArea, generate isolated transparent PNG components for Godot assembly. Do not use the deprecated full-canvas scene layer workflow for base/foreground/collision/contact assets.
rules.component_background: When transparent=true, output a real alpha PNG. Do not bake checkerboard, white, gray, or preview backgrounds into the image.
rules.component_perspective: Every HomeArea component must share the same fixed 3/4 top-down view, scale language, lighting, and hand-painted storybook style.
rules.ui_replacement: UI assets replace the same runtime paths under assets/ui/ without changing Godot scripts.
rules.character_replacement: Character and portrait assets replace the same runtime paths referenced by game/data/npcs.json and character scenes.
rules.approval_boundary: All generated assets are review_ready until human visual approval. Do not mark launch_quality_approved true.
